title: [06.03] Map - TTTM Happy Valley (1982 vs 2012)
prompt: The diagrams below show changes in Happy Valley Shopping Centre in 1982 and 2012. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.
guide:
### 📌 CHIẾN THUẬT TIẾP CẬN DẠNG MAP (TRẠM IELTS)

Đối với sơ đồ khu mua sắm/trung tâm thương mại ngoài trời, chúng ta vẫn phân chia theo các góc Đông - Tây - Nam - Bắc để miêu tả vị trí các gian hàng một cách khoa học.

---
### PHẦN 1: HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT INTRODUCTION (1 câu)

#### Bước 1: Paraphrase đề bài
* *changes in Happy Valley Shopping Centre* => *the structural alterations and commercial redevelopment of the Happy Valley Shopping Centre*.
* *in 1982 and 2012* => *over a 30-year period from 1982 to 2012*.

#### Bước 2: Câu viết hoàn chỉnh
> *The diagrams illustrate the layout changes that occurred at the Happy Valley Shopping Centre over a 30-year period between 1982 and 2012.*

---
### PHẦN 2: HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT OVERVIEW (2 câu)

#### Bước 1: Phân tích 2 điểm nổi bật
* **Xu hướng quy hoạch:** Trung tâm thương mại được mở rộng về mặt thương mại và tiện ích đỗ xe bằng cách lấp đi hồ nước tự nhiên.
* **Thay đổi mặt bằng:** Bổ sung bãi đỗ xe lớn, nhà hàng theo chủ đề (Themed Restaurants) và tái cơ cấu lại vị trí của các cửa hàng bán lẻ.

#### Bước 2: Câu viết hoàn chỉnh
* **Câu 1 (Xu hướng chung):** *Overall, the shopping centre became significantly more functional and commercially oriented, shifting from a leisure-focused space with natural scenery to an expanded retail complex.*
* **Câu 2 (Thay đổi nổi bật):** *The most striking changes were the removal of the lake to create parking and retail facilities, along with the rearrangement of various retail outlets.*

---
### PHẦN 3: CHIẾN THUẬT CHIA THÂN BÀI (PARAGRAPH DIVISION)

* **Body 1 (Khu vực phía Tây & Tây Nam):** Hồ nước bị lấp => Bãi đỗ xe (Parking Lot) và Cửa hàng nội thất (Furniture Retail); Cổng vào được thiết kế lại.
* **Body 2 (Khu vực Trung tâm và phía Đông):** Khu giải trí ở giữa được giữ nguyên; Cửa hàng thể thao & điện tử dời lên phía Bắc; Nhà hàng theo chủ đề xuất hiện ở phía Đông; Cửa hàng đồ ăn chuyển xuống góc Đông Nam.

---
### PHẦN 4: HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT CHI TIẾT TỪNG BODY

#### BODY 1: KHU VỰC PHÍA TÂY VÀ LỐI VÀO (3 câu)
* **Câu 1 (Hồ nước bị thay thế hoàn toàn):** *In 1982, the western portion of the shopping centre was dominated by a large natural lake surrounded by trees.*
* **Câu 2 (Xây bãi đỗ xe và khu nội thất):** *By 2012, this lake had been completely filled in to accommodate a spacious parking lot and a large furniture retail store.*
* **Câu 3 (Sảnh chính và Lối vào):** *The main entrance was relocated slightly to the south, while the adjacent toilets and elevator to the second floor remained in their original positions.*

#### BODY 2: KHU VỰC TRUNG TÂM VÀ PHÍA ĐÔNG (3-4 câu)
* **Câu 1 (Khu giải trí trung tâm giữ nguyên):** *In the central area, the entertainment zone was preserved over the 30-year span, though the coffee shop to its north was removed.*
* **Câu 2 (Tái định vị cửa hàng thể thao & điện tử):** *Directly above the entertainment area, new sports and electronics stores were established, replacing the original food store.*
* **Câu 3 (Khu ẩm thực mới ở phía Đông):** *On the eastern side, the former retail shops were demolished to introduce a specialized themed restaurant zone.*
* **Câu 4 (Cửa hàng ăn uống góc Đông Nam):** *Meanwhile, the food store was repositioned to the South-East corner, situated just south of the new restaurant complex.*

---
### PHẦN 5: TỔNG HỢP CÔNG THỨC DỄ NHỚ CHO MAP

1. **Intro:** `The diagrams illustrate the layout changes in [địa điểm] over a [30]-year period from [1982] to [2012].`
2. **Overview:** `Overall, the centre became more commercially focused. Key alterations included the removal of the lake for parking and the relocation of shops.`
3. **Body 1 (West):** `In the West, the lake was filled in to make way for [parking lot] and [retail store]. The entrance was relocated.`
4. **Body 2 (East & Center):** `The central entertainment zone was kept. On the East, former shops were replaced by [themed restaurants], while the food store was moved to the South-East.`

---
### PHẦN 6: BÀI BÁO CÁO MẪU HOÀN CHỈNH (BAND 7.0 - 7.5)

The diagrams illustrate the layout changes that occurred at the Happy Valley Shopping Centre over a 30-year period between 1982 and 2012.

Overall, the shopping centre became significantly more functional and commercially oriented, shifting from a leisure-focused space with natural scenery to an expanded retail complex. The most striking changes were the removal of the lake to create parking and retail facilities, along with the rearrangement of various retail outlets.

In 1982, the western portion of the shopping centre was dominated by a large natural lake surrounded by trees. By 2012, this lake had been completely filled in to accommodate a spacious parking lot and a large furniture retail store. The main entrance was relocated slightly to the south, while the adjacent toilets and elevator to the second floor remained in their original positions.

In the central area, the entertainment zone was preserved over the 30-year span, though the coffee shop to its north was removed. Directly above the entertainment area, new sports and electronics stores were established, replacing the original food store. On the eastern side, the former retail shops were demolished to introduce a specialized themed restaurant zone. Meanwhile, the food store was repositioned to the South-East corner, situated just south of the new restaurant complex.
